title: Experiment: No Comment Scores
author: pg
excerpt: Over the years several people have suggested not displaying comment scores. I finally decided to try it. There are so many users now that voting is starting to have a bit of a mob feel to it. We'll see if this makes the site feel better. Voting still has all the same effects (on karma, and on position on the page), so I encourage users to keep doing it. The only difference is that comment scores aren't displayed in threads.
guide_zh: HN 试验隐藏评论分数，希望改善随大众投票的氛围。
